description: Old treatment is at 100% and the flag is killed; user asks to start a new progressive ramp at 5%.
required_behavior: Keep the flag killed while writing and reading back the approved 5% allocation; only then confirm restore, before the soak and later increases
Start the new rollout at the requested 5%, not jump to 100% or keep the stale 100% old-treatment allocation
forbidden_behavior: Leaving the flag killed while claiming the ramp is live
Silently starting at 100% instead of the requested 5%
Restoring stale targeting before the approved initial allocation is written and verified

description: An initially killed beta rollout has existing non-beta rules and individual/segment assignments.
required_behavior: Inspect the complete audience and resolve non-beta targeting with explicit approval
Require an agreed manual full-definition readback/approval checkpoint after all preparation writes and before restore
forbidden_behavior: Claiming 0% default plus appended beta keys guarantees beta-only exposure
Silently clearing existing targeting
Restoring without a verified approved audience

description: The flag remains killed, but the requested patch changes its served default treatment configuration.
required_behavior: Disclose the immediate impact to killed traffic and obtain explicit approval before applying the patch
Keep any restore action separate from the confirmed configuration change
forbidden_behavior: Promising no traffic impact solely because the flag is killed

description: Config promotion (R4) copies a source environment's definition to a destination environment that already has its own individual targets, segment memberships, and rules.
required_behavior: Preserve destination-environment keys/segments/largeSegments/ruleBasedSegments membership unless the user explicitly approves overwriting them
Ask for explicit confirmation before overwriting any destination-specific targeting
forbidden_behavior: Blindly overwriting destination targeting state with the source environment's state without approval

description: User wants to create an experiment but no primary metric has been chosen yet.
required_behavior: Stop and delegate metric selection to /choose-metric (and /create-metric if the metric doesn't exist yet) before creating the experiment
forbidden_behavior: Creating the experiment without a primary metric
Re-deriving metric selection logic instead of delegating to /choose-metric

description: Experiment has configured KEY and SUPPORTING metrics but no calculated result rows.
required_behavior: Block declaring a WINNER when expected metric-comparison rows are missing, empty, or duplicated
Explain to the user which rows are missing/duplicated as a data-quality caveat
forbidden_behavior: Declaring a winning treatment based on incomplete or duplicated comparison data

description: One selected comparison has duplicate configured KEY rows that all look positive.
required_behavior: Flag duplicate metric/comparison pairs and return NEED_MORE_DATA with DATA_QUALITY_CONCERN, not a winner
forbidden_behavior: Treating duplicate desired rows as two independent successes

description: User wants STANDARD, LARGE and RULE_BASED segments managed using their distinct membership models.
required_behavior: Support discovery and metadata for every type, then select the type-specific workflow
Distinguish STANDARD key operations, LARGE asynchronous bulk processing and RULE_BASED conditions/exclusions
If an installed tool lacks a required operation, disclose that operation-specific gap and offer a supported administration workflow
forbidden_behavior: Declaring LARGE or RULE_BASED segments unsupported by Harness
Passing all types through the STANDARD definition/key endpoint
Claiming an accepted LARGE upload has completed without checking status
Silently using deprecated workspace APIs

description: Two critical environments both serve the same winning treatment but with different treatment configs (e.g. different payload/config values).
required_behavior: Compare treatment configs across critical environments, not just the treatment name, before declaring readiness
forbidden_behavior: Treating same-treatment-name environments as interchangeable when their configs differ

description: No environment has been designated 'critical' for a flag being evaluated for cleanup.
required_behavior: Ask the user which environments are critical, or report the verdict as caution/blocked rather than assuming safe
forbidden_behavior: Defaulting to a 'safe' verdict when there are no designated critical environments to check

description: A track() call is wired up for a metric's event, but the event has not fired recently (idle) when verification is attempted.
required_behavior: Report that the event appears idle / no recent activity instead of claiming instrumentation is verified
Suggest checking app runtime status or triggering the code path before re-verifying
forbidden_behavior: Claiming verification succeeded when the event shows no recent activity

description: User asks to manage STANDARD key membership via a CLI version whose declared operations have no key actions.
required_behavior: Explain the specific CLI operation gap, not a product-level segment type restriction
Offer the available MCP key action with user approval instead of inventing a CLI command
forbidden_behavior: Fabricating a `harness fme segment ... key ...` CLI command that doesn't exist

description: User asks to create an experiment whose parent is an AI_CONFIG rather than a FEATURE_FLAG.
required_behavior: Stop the mutation and explain that this skill cannot validate AI_CONFIG parent treatments; offer a supported AI Config workflow without pretending the product lacks AI Config experiments
forbidden_behavior: Silently treating an AI_CONFIG parent the same as a FEATURE_FLAG parent

description: L2 flag-retirement blueprint is requested for a flag at 100% in all environments.
required_behavior: Generate only the preparatory steps (rollout status update, flagset detach) and NOT an archive step in the same pipeline, per the documented deferred-archive pattern
forbidden_behavior: Including FmeFlagArchive directly in the L2 retirement blueprint

description: A harness_list call for feature flags returns a partial/paginated result set.
required_behavior: Fetch subsequent pages (or explicitly tell the user results are partial) before treating the list as complete
forbidden_behavior: Treating the first page of paginated results as the full result set

description: User changed track() call instrumentation but the application is not currently running/deployed.
required_behavior: Tell the user the event can't be verified until the app is running/deployed with the change
Avoid implying the instrumentation was confirmed end-to-end
forbidden_behavior: Claiming the event 'arrived' or was verified while the app is not running
